note: byte equality with the source proves faithful transfer, not substantive completeness

residual_risks.RR1: Phase 2 is built while staging does not exist (Mike's Q4), so ADR 0014's "staging exists before feature work" is not met, the core schema's first contact with a deployed stack comes later than the phase intends, and the criterion "core schema migrated on staging" stays open in a separate bead until jade-4zw lands.
residual_risks.RR10: "Each QR scans on a phone" and "legible in greyscale" are proven by automated decoding in two browser engines and a black-and-white-only check, plus one manual print and scan by Mike; printers, paper and phone cameras at the pilot site are not covered.
residual_risks.RR11: The first real migration-compat run happens on jade-o07's pull request and may expose faults in the harness or exceed its nine-minute timeout; such a fault delays the merge, since the job is never weakened.
residual_risks.RR12: jade-pe9 cannot be implemented before Phase 3, so the Phase 2 epic stays open after its other beads close, revoke and reissue do not exist until then, and its specification here may need revision once jade-vcy and jade-aq5 fix the session and matrix interfaces.
residual_risks.RR13: The five-minute fresh-clone criterion is measured on the development machine with warm caches; a first download of dependencies, browsers and images on a slow connection can take longer.
residual_risks.RR14: The core migration grants jade_app the verbs that Phase 3 features need on users, sessions, invites, classes, class_kits and device_sessions before those features exist, so for a while the app role can write tables that no code writes.
residual_risks.RR15: When the operator's machine or container dies without closing its connections, the server keeps the generator's label lock and its open transaction until TCP keepalive notices, so until then a rerun answers CODES_BATCH_IN_PROGRESS; a hash collision of two labels' lock keys makes an unrelated label wait in the same way.
residual_risks.RR16: If the first app process of an environment runs with the wrong pepper, it stores the wrong key-check value; the generator then refuses and, with Q2(5)'s recommendation, the deploy fails its health gate, but the row stays wrong until the owner removes it by jade-lnn.1's guarded runbook step, which is possible only while no code exists.
residual_risks.RR2: Whatever Q1 decides is printed on every card of a batch and cannot be changed for that batch; with the query-string form the plain code reaches the request line and the adult device's browser history, and with the fragment form it still sits in the history until the redeem page of jade-bu6 removes it.
residual_risks.RR3: The global failed-code throttle is shared by everyone (TM-6, accepted by ADR 0020), its initial threshold of 100 failures in ten minutes is untuned until jade-6cq, and because it is read without a lock it can be exceeded by up to the number of concurrent attempts.
residual_risks.RR4: audit_log has no retention or deletion rule in any source; its rows hold adult account ids and kit, class and code-row ids inside jsonb, are not reached by the kit-deletion enumeration, and are kept after a kit's data is deleted.
residual_risks.RR5: device_sessions is created in Phase 2 with its last_seen_at column while the threat-model item TM-5 (whether a row for a kit with logging off is stored activity under rule 2) is still open; Phase 2 writes no row to it.
residual_risks.RR6: The key derivation, message form and check-character algorithm of ADR 0026 are permanent once a card is printed, losing or rotating the pepper invalidates every printed code, the code lookup is an index probe that is not constant-time, and with option Q2(5) the database holds one HMAC of a fixed label under the pepper.
residual_risks.RR7: Nothing in this plan was installed or run: the SQL that drizzle-kit 0.31 emits for citext, bytea, identity, check and partial-index definitions, the API of qrcode-generator 2.0.4 and the canvas decoding with jsqr may differ in detail at implementation, and a difference that changes a mechanism returns to planloop.
residual_risks.RR8: If the generator's two files are lost after a successful run, the batch's kits and codes remain in the database as rows nobody can print or redeem until a staff revoke exists (jade-pe9), the label stays taken, and no source says when printed cards and the packing CSV are destroyed.
residual_risks.RR9: The generator and the seed connect as jade_owner, a superuser in the Compose stacks, and a generator run holds the owner URL and the pepper in one process on the operator's machine or container.
